summary_en: Azbil executed a ToSTNeT-3 off-hours share buyback on November 11, 2026, acquiring 8,379,800 shares at ¥1,432 per share (¥11,999,873,600 total), representing 2.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Share Buyback Through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Azbil's board of directors authorized the execution of a share buyback under the Companies Act Article 156 (as applied by Article 165, Paragraph 3). The company completed a ToSTNeT-3 off-hours purchase on November 11, 2026, at 08:45 AM Japan Standard Time on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The execution details are as follows: 8,379,800 shares were acquired at a fixed price of ¥1,432 per share, totaling ¥11,999,873,600. This represents 2.1% of shares outstanding (calculated as 8,379,800 ÷ 399,213,000 × 100), where 399,213,000 is the number of issued shares excluding treasury stock as of the acquisition date. The purchase order was a time-limited order for the specified trading session only.

This execution is part of a broader share buyback authorization approved on the same date, which permits acquisitions of up to 15,000,000 shares (3.0% of outstanding shares) for up to ¥15,000 million through open market purchases over the period from November 11, 2026, to January 27, 2027. The company noted that settlement of actual acquisitions depends on sell orders matching the buy order, and that market conditions could result in partial or no execution.
